environment: Existing host-B vLLM 0.32.0; installed source commit unknown

observations.fact: Separates sliding/full attention layers, passes sliding_window per layer, and selects layer-type-specific rope_parameters without overriding the full-attention partial rotary factor.
Declares sliding-window support, maps FP8 E4M3 to torch.float8_e4m3fn, supports head dimensions 64/128/256/512 and compute capability through 12.1. This is source eligibility, not a launch pass.
Supports SM120/121 and sliding windows, but head sizes stop at 256; Gemma4 full attention uses 512. Optional b12x package is also checked. It is not a whole-model alternate for this checkpoint.
Composite requires FlashAttention v3/v4 and declares device_major=9; not assumed usable on SM121.
Exposes explicit attention backend and per-KV-cache-kind overrides.
For heterogeneous Gemma4 head dimensions, absent FA4 forces TRITON_ATTN only when attention_config.backend is None. An explicitly requested alternate backend is not overwritten by this branch.

restriction: No installed engine source or package was modified; an actual launch must establish compatibility of a selected alternate.
